add.face_sub: The time, the weather, what's next or any sensor, as a card you can turn to. Starts as a copy of your glance.
add.nothing: Nothing else can be a card.
alarm.alarmo: Alarmo: countdowns in seconds, the sensor that set it off, and “Arm anyway” with a door open.
alarm.any_length: Any length: a ✓ after 0 sends it
alarm.code_about: The Nest asks for a code whenever the alarm wants one, and it checks it; Fledge never keeps it. Three wrong codes lock the code pad for 30 s, longer each time.
alarm.copy_alarmo: Copy names from its Alarmo card
alarm.letters: This alarm's code has letters, which the ring can't enter: disarm it from Home Assistant.
alarm.modes_about: After Back, in this order. A name shows on the ring and as “Armed · name” on the card; blank keeps Home Assistant's.
alarm.no_alarmo: No Alarmo card for this alarm on a dashboard.
alarm.no_delays: This alarm doesn't say how long its delays are, so the ring shows time running without the seconds.
alarm.no_modes: This alarm has no modes to arm to.
alarm.takeover_sub: When someone comes in (the entry delay) or it goes off, the Nest lights up on it; the code pad first, if it needs a code
banner.not_running: Fledge isn't running for this thermostat (its setup failed or it's disabled), so changes won't reach the Nest until it is.
banner.outdated: The Nest runs an older Fledge build than this integration needs: some cards may not work until it updates (Thermostat tab).
battery.choose: Choose anything with a battery percentage: a car, a home battery, a mower.
battery.image_about: An image takes the icon's place: a file in Home Assistant's www folder (/local/car.png), an image uploaded to Home Assistant (its /api/image/serve/… address), or a web address. Best wide, side on and see-through.
battery.invert_sub: For a power that reads below zero going in, as many home batteries do
battery.line_about: The line under the number is worked out from these: Charging · 7.2 kW, Plugged in, or a discharge's power. Without a charging entity, power going in counts as charging (above zero, or below with Negative while charging on). The white notch on the ring is the charge limit.
battery.otherwise: Otherwise it shows the line chosen below.
card.kept_first: The Nest's Fledge build keeps it first until it updates (Thermostat tab).
card.name: Name on the Nest
card.not_acting: This Nest isn't acting as a thermostat, so it has no card of its own. Turn it back on in the Thermostat tab.
card.show_off: Hidden: the Nest still heats, set from Home Assistant
card.show_on: Turn it to set the temperature, as the Nest always did
cards.settings_last: Settings always comes last on the Nest.
common.rebooting: The Nest is rebooting into it.
empty.text: Add the Fledge integration for your Nest first.
empty.title: No thermostat yet
face.hold: A long press, with the card open
face.hold_note: Only an action that's on the ring, so a hold never does something the ring doesn't show.
face.no_actions: None yet: a scene, script or button to run, or a light or switch to turn on and off.
face.outdated_card: The Nest's Fledge build is older than face cards: it leaves this card out until it updates (Thermostat tab).
face.press_actions: Opens it full screen; press again for its actions
face.press_back: Opens it full screen; press again to go back
far.about: Fledge keeps the Nest's Farsight on, so its motion sensor always reports at once. Nothing keeps the screen fully dark.
far.glance_sub: What you chose on the Glance tab: the time, the weather and what's on, to start
far.title: Someone across the room
far.wake_sub: As if the ring had turned
glance.aria: The glance as the Nest shows it
glance.automations: Automations can change the day's layout with the Glance layout entity. Night glance says which one is up.
glance.choose_number: Choose a sensor with a number: a price, a power, a battery.
glance.colour: Colour the screen while heating or cooling
glance.colour_sub: Orange or blue, as the Nest's own Farsight
glance.face_aria: The face as the Nest shows it
glance.face_note: A card's face is the same day and night, and never dimmed: someone is standing at it.
glance.outdated_date: The Nest's Fledge build is a little older than this panel: the date's words and order and how dim the night is wait for its update.
glance.outdated_faces: The Nest's Fledge build is older than face cards: it leaves them out until it updates.
glance.outdated_layouts: The Nest's Fledge build is older than these layouts: it shows the clock as before until it updates.
glance.room: {layout} has room for {count} lines, top to bottom.
glance.room_note: A line with nothing to say takes no room: the ones below move up.
glance.shared_faces: For the glance and every face
glance.skip_all_day_sub: Birthdays, bin days and the like
glance.speaker: Speaker (none: whichever of your cards' speakers is playing)
glance.tried_outdated: Sent, but the Nest's Fledge build is too old to show it. Update it on the Thermostat tab.
glance.try_face: Shows this face on the Nest for 20 seconds, without saving it.
glance.try_glance: Shows this glance on the Nest for 20 seconds, without saving it.
glance.unshown: Nothing shows the glance yet. Choose it for someone across the room or close up.
glance.want_card: Want this as a card you can turn to?
glance.weather: Weather (also the Nest's own weather screen)
heat.about_off: For radiator valves or zoning in Home Assistant: the Nest only fires the boiler when Home Assistant's Call for heat switch asks it to. Its schedule waits aside and comes back if Home Assistant stops asking.
heat.about_on: Your automations, valves or zoning decide when to heat by turning the Call for heat switch on and off. The Call for heat switch is the only say: a temperature set on the Nest's dial or its climate entity is put back. If Home Assistant stops asking for 10 minutes, the Nest goes back to its own schedule.
heat.ask_off:
Give heating control back to the Nest?

Its own schedule and learning come back now, and it heats as it did before. Home Assistant's Call for heat switch stops doing anything.
heat.ask_on:
Let Home Assistant decide when to heat?

The Nest's schedule is put aside and the boiler only fires while the Call for heat switch is on. Until an automation turns it on, the heating stays OFF (the Nest's safety temperature still protects against frost).

If Home Assistant stops asking for 10 minutes, the Nest goes back to its own schedule.
heat.done_off: The Nest decides when to heat again.
heat.done_on: Home Assistant decides when to heat now.
heat.off: Off: the Nest decides when to heat
heat.phase_heating: Home Assistant is calling for heat
heat.phase_nest: Off: the Nest runs its own schedule
heat.phase_on_its_own: On, nothing asking: the Nest runs its own schedule
heat.title: Heating control by Home Assistant
hint.choose_speaker: Choose a speaker: none of your cards is one.
hint.instead: Nothing to say now, so instead:
hint.no_forecast: No forecast from this weather entity yet.
hint.no_hourly: No hourly forecast from this weather entity.
hint.no_sun: Home Assistant has no sun entity.
hint.no_temperature: The thermostat isn't reporting its temperature.
hint.none_playing: None of your cards' speakers is playing now, so the line is empty.
hint.not_now: Not showing now: its state isn't the one asked for.
hint.not_playing: It isn't playing now, so the line is empty.
kind.speaker: Speaker
limit.about: The ring's ends: a full ring is the highest, an empty one the lowest, and the Nest says when it's at one. Blank, as far as it goes. A limit that can be pushed past gives way if you keep turning; one that can't holds. Home Assistant can still set it anywhere.
limit.own_note: The Nest's own dial (Settings on the Nest) and its schedule aren't held to them.
limit.own_outdated: The Nest's Fledge build is older than limits on its own card: it turns as far as it goes until it updates (Thermostat tab).
limit.push_newer: Needs a newer Fledge on the Nest
limit.title: Ring limits
limit.wrong: The lowest has to be under the highest, or this limit is ignored.
line.none_instead: Nothing: the lines below move up
near.about: Close enough to reach it, without touching it.
near.glance_sub: The same as across the room
near.none_sub: Only what across the room shows
near.title: Someone comes up to it
night.choose_sensor: Choose the sensor: until then it's always day.
night.dim_sub: Drawn darker and warmer, on top of the Nest's own brightness
night.is_day: By these settings it's day now.
night.is_night: By these settings it's night now.
night.off: Never: the same glance all day
night.off_about: The Nest shows the day's glance all the time. Choose when night is to use this one.
night.title: When it's night
night.unavailable_day: If the sensor is unavailable, it's day.
notify.about: It shows on every Nest running Fledge. A press or a dismissal fires {event}.
notify.tag: Add {tag} to dismiss it later with {dismiss}.
notify.title: Try a notification
preview.not_in_ha: Not in Home Assistant, so not on the Nest
preview.try: Turn the ring to try your order
ring.alarm_code: Turn to each digit, press to enter it, hold to rub out
ring.alarm_entry: Takes the screen, straight to the code
ring.alarm_press: Opens it: press again to arm or disarm
ring.climate_menu: Its menu: mode, and presets, fan and swing where it has them
ring.its_options: Its options: turn to one, press to choose it
ring.light_menu: Its menu: on / off, warmth and colour where it has them
ring.media_menu: Its menu: play / pause, next and previous
ring.opens_run: Opens it: press again for Run
ring.thermostat_press: Its dial; press again for eco, off and hot water
role.about: Using something else for your heating? Turn this off to keep the Nest as a panel for your cards. Its heating switches off, and it stops being a thermostat in Home Assistant.
role.about_water: Using something else for your heating? Turn this off to keep the Nest as a panel for your cards. Its heating and hot water switch off, and it stops being a thermostat in Home Assistant.
role.done_off: The Nest's heating is off: it's a panel now.
role.done_on: The Nest is a thermostat again.
role.not_about: Its heating is off (its hot water too, if it has it), and Home Assistant has only its sensors. Turn this back on to heat again as before.
role.off_card: Its card and heating settings go from the Nest's screen. Your other cards stay.
role.off_ha: Home Assistant loses its thermostat: the climate entity, schedules, Eco, Auto-Schedule, Home/Away and the other heating controls. Automations and dashboards that use them stop working.
role.off_heating: Its heating turns off now, and nothing can turn it back on while it's off. Its safety temperatures still protect against frost.
role.off_heating_water: Its heating and hot water turn off now, and nothing can turn them back on while it's off. Its safety temperatures still protect against frost.
role.off_sensors: Its temperature and humidity sensors stay, with its motion, light and power sensors.
role.on_card: Its card and heating settings come back on the Nest's screen.
role.on_ha: Home Assistant gets its thermostat and heating controls back, with the same entity IDs.
role.on_heating: Its heating goes back to the mode it was in (its hot water schedule too, if it had one), and it heats again if that calls for it.
role.outdated: Update Fledge on the Nest to use it only as a panel, without its thermostat.
save.done: Saved. The Nest has its new cards.
schedule.card_heating_about: The Nest's own weekly heating schedule, with an editor and Copy to days.
schedule.card_heating_editor_about: The heating schedule editor on its own, for a popup.
schedule.card_water_about: The Nest's own weekly hot water schedule, with an editor and Copy to days.
schedule.card_water_editor_about: The hot water schedule editor on its own, for a popup.
schedule.copy_about: The days you choose get {day}'s {what}, replacing what they have.
schedule.form_edit_help: A link like #heating_schedule to your own popup with the editor card; left empty, the card's own editor opens.
schedule.no_changes: No changes: it stays at the temperature from the day before.
schedule.no_heating: No heating schedule from this Nest yet.
schedule.no_hot_water: No hot water schedule from this Nest yet.
schedule.no_schedule: No schedule from this Nest yet.
schedule.not_shown: The Nest hasn't shown {days} yet. Is it online? Save again to retry.
schedule.runs_into_first: The last time runs into the first
screen.settings.title: Settings
temps.about: The Nest's own weather screen and the glance show this weather.
temps.ask_off: Turn the external temperature option off? The Nest reboots (its heating pauses for about a minute) and goes back to its own sensor and Bluetooth.
temps.ask_on: Turn the external temperature option on? The Nest reboots (its heating pauses for about a minute) and its Bluetooth turns off, so real Nest Temperature Sensors stop working.
temps.ignored: This Nest runs without the external temperature option, so it ignores the readings for now.
temps.ignored_update: Update its Fledge to turn the option on from here.
temps.room_about: The Nest regulates from this sensor instead of its own, and goes back to its own if the readings stop.
temps.room_option: It needs the Nest's external temperature option, which turns off its Bluetooth: real Nest Temperature Sensors stop working.
temps.title: Weather and temperature
thermostat.checking: Asked the Nest to look for an update.
wake.about: You walk up, turn the ring or press it while the screen is dark.
wake.auto_sub: The speaker that's playing, else after sunset a light that's on, else the chooser
wake.chooser_sub: The thermostat among your cards, zoomed out
wake.dim_off: Turning a light down past 1% turns it off
wake.dim_off_sub: The ring holds at 1% for a moment first. A switch turns off to the left and on to the right.
wake.glance_tab: What the glance shows is chosen on the Glance tab.
wake.title: When the Nest wakes
wwn.about: For a Nest with no Heat Link, or a boiler wired straight to the Nest's own base. Without it, a Nest that can't find its Heat Link can stop with error H71 or H74. Changing it reboots the Nest.
wwn.ask_off:
Turn Works With Nest boiler off?

The Nest goes back to heating through its Heat Link. If it has no Heat Link it may stop with error H71 or H74.

The Nest reboots now, and its heating pauses for about a minute.
wwn.ask_on:
Turn Works With Nest boiler on?

The Nest stops using its Heat Link and switches the boiler itself, through the W1 wire on its own base. Only do this if the Nest has no Heat Link, or the boiler is wired to the Nest's base: a boiler wired to a Heat Link won't come on.

The Nest reboots now, and its heating pauses for about a minute.
wwn.off: Off: heats through its Heat Link
wwn.on: On: heats through its own W1 wire, no Heat Link
wwn.title: Works With Nest boiler
